about: Pieces of cyber-romo that are other people's work with no license declared, so this repo does not copy them. install.sh downloads each one from its author's GitHub repo at the pinned commit (codeload.github.com/<repo>/tar.gz/<commit>), takes <path> from it, applies <patch> (cyber-romo's changes, `patch -p1` inside the mod folder) when there is one, and installs it as <name>. export.sh regenerates each patch from the live setup. An agent can do the same by hand: see the README's 'Piezas de terceros' section.

items.name: file-editor
items.what: File explorer and tabbed editor (the Files panel), v0.1.1, used unchanged

items.name: spaces-icons
items.what: Spaces with each project's avatar or icon; the patch adds worktrees under their repo and a button to fold them

items.name: tabs-graph
items.what: Pill tabs plus the Files / Changes / Graph buttons
